limitations: This small model covers only the 15 public reserved-class operator body variants on POST /runtime/{scope}, not binding RPC, private settlement, or other routes.
HTTP success responses have a result envelope; rawResponse is intentionally not applied to nested arrays or scalar result values.
D1 migration results and statement engine metadata remain native Document values pending a separate SQL-engine model audit.
The handlers return application errors with HTTP 400, not an HTTP 200 success/error union. Common HTTP status errors are supplied by the parent core.
Peer headers must be signed against the exact serialized body and encoded path/query. This source model does not implement signing, discovery, retries or transport.

traits.smithy.api#documentation: Reserved D1, KV and Queue operator requests. All operations use POST /runtime/{scope}; the reserved scope and JSON body select the operation. Peer authentication protocol version is 5.
